_about: Test cases for the Pixel Buds protocol. hdlc and crc32 are pbpctrl's own tests (github.com/qzed/pbpctrl, libmaestro/src/hdlc, Maximilian Luz, MIT). ids are the service and method ids OpenControl for Pixel Buds Pro 2 saw a Pixel Buds Pro 2 receive (github.com/tedsluis/opencontrolpixelbudspro2, PROTOCOL.md section 4.5: 1d ea71de7e 25 1d9a8c9e; AGPL, used as facts), which pw_rpc's 65599 hash of the names gives. requests were built by hand with an independent implementation (Python, outside the repo) from the layout in docs/pixel/PROTOCOL.md and Google's Pixel Buds app 1.0.990706425; they are not captures.

requests.what: probe channel 18 with GetSoftwareInfo, call id FFFFFFFF
read Allegro setting 13 (noise control) on channel 18
write noise control adaptive (13 = 4) on channel 18
write the Heavy bass preset (16 = 5, 3, 0, 0, 0) on channel 18
press and hold on the right earbud: digital assistant (7 = {2: {4: {1: 6}}})
write Pixel Buds (2020) in-ear detection off
write the A-Series bass level 2 (sent as 3)
write Pixel Buds (2020) attention alerts: on, a dog barking on
